facts.en: Completed a business operations diploma at Fictional Amberwheel Academy in 2021.

facts.en: Completed an internal spreadsheet course in 2024-06; it was not a vendor certification.
facts.zh: 2024-06 完成内部电子表格课程；并非厂商认证。

facts.en: Customer support clerk at Fictional Beacon Ledger, 2021-09 to 2023-12.
facts.zh: 2021-09 至 2023-12 在虚构信标账簿机构任客户支持文员。

facts.en: Customer success operations assistant at Fictional Beacon Ledger, 2024-01 to 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2026-09 在虚构信标账簿机构任客户成功运营助理。

facts.en: Checks onboarding task records in a CRM and reminds account owners of missing due dates.
facts.zh: 在 CRM 中检查入门任务记录，并提醒客户负责人补齐到期日期。

facts.en: Tracked 61 active onboarding records in 2026-09; the 2025-04 seasonal peak was 94 records, not personally owned accounts.
facts.zh: 2026-09 跟踪 61 条活跃入门记录；2025-04 季节高峰为 94 条记录，并非个人负责的客户账户。

facts.en: Worked with a success manager on an onboarding completeness dashboard during 2025-01 to 2025-03.
facts.zh: 2025-01 至 2025-03 与客户成功经理共同制作入门信息完整度仪表板。

facts.en: Personally wrote spreadsheet validation formulas and maintained field definitions; the manager chose the operating thresholds.
facts.zh: 个人编写电子表格校验公式并维护字段定义；运营阈值由经理选定。

facts.en: In 2025-05, 45 of 50 sampled records had a next-action date, versus 31 of 48 in 2025-01; this measures record completeness, not retention.
facts.zh: 2025-05 抽样 50 条记录中，45 条有下一步行动日期；2025-01 抽样 48 条中为 31 条；此指标衡量记录完整度，而非留存率。

facts.en: Drafted a renewal-risk tag taxonomy in 2026-04; managers had not deployed it by 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2026-04 起草续约风险标签分类；截至 2026-09 经理们尚未部署。

facts.en: Uses CRM exports, spreadsheet pivot tables, and documented exception queues.
facts.zh: 使用 CRM 导出文件、电子表格数据透视表及有文档说明的异常队列。

facts.en: Coordinates handoff notes between support and account teams without negotiating commercial terms.
facts.zh: 协调支持团队与客户团队之间的交接笔记，不协商商务条款。

facts.en: In 2024-11, built a personal board-game loan tracker for 22 fictional items.
facts.zh: 2024-11 为 22 件虚构物品制作个人桌游借用跟踪表。

facts.en: Enjoys urban sketching and does not monetize the drawings.
facts.zh: 爱好城市速写，不通过画作获利。

facts.en: Volunteered as a book-sorting helper at Fictional Reading Exchange during 2025-08 weekends.
facts.zh: 2025-08 周末在虚构阅读交换活动任图书分类志愿助手。

facts.en: An unsigned slide attributes a 9% retention uplift to the dashboard without a cohort or period; the claim is unverified.
facts.zh: 一张未署名幻灯片将 9% 留存提升归因于仪表板，但未注明群体或期间；该主张未经核实。

facts.en: A role note says CRM administrator, but documented access covered record updates and exports only; permission ownership is unclear.
facts.zh: 一条岗位备注称 CRM 管理员，但有记录的权限仅包括记录更新及导出；权限管理责任不明确。

facts.en: No SQL production querying or revenue forecasting responsibility is documented.
